notes.title: Free to play now!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44601561/66f388cab9ea9b9c7da52cd0f151c264676c849d.png[/img]

[b]Brick on the Head is now free to play![/b]

As a manager of an hospital near bankrupt, you find that a brick on the head will give you patients. Throw objects in the streets along four worlds with levels full of madness and fun. Also play on Hospital Mode where you can build your own hospital, take care of patients, protect him with security guards...

[b]Pick carefully your items for every level, there a lot ways to play![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44601561/348f4c63a5cdb467876f511bd19cec79d5884f62.gif[/img]

[b]Different types of Enemies and Allies![/b]
